title: yearEstablished accepts implausible years — no min (1800) / max (currentYear) guard; year 1 or 3999 accepted without error
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/VendorFormWizard.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `yearEstablished` input has no min or max validation. Year 1 or year 3999 is accepted without error.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Add Yup validation: `yearEstablished: Yup.number().integer().min(1800, 'Year must be 1800 or later').max(new Date().getFullYear(), \`Year cannot be in the future\`).nullable()`. Add `min="1800"` and `max={new Date().getFullYear()}` to the Input component.

title: Legacy /vendors/list silent redirect — returns null and calls `router.replace()` with no loading state or explanation for bookmarked users
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/app/(private)/vendors/list/page.jsx` **Root Cause:** Returns `null` and immediately calls `router.replace('/vendors')` with no loading state or user explanation. Bookmarked users see a blank flash before redirect. **Claude Fix Prompt:** Replace blank redirect with a loading state: `export default function VendorsListRedirect() { const router = useRouter(); useEffect(() => { router.replace('/vendors'); }, []); return (
Redirecting to vendor registry…
); }`.

title: riskTier and Trust Score never shown side-by-side — Trust Score not a default column; manual riskTier=low + trustScore=18/100 raises no visible flag during registry review
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/VendorRegistry.jsx`
**Root Cause:** Trust Score is not a default column in the registry table. Manual `riskTier: low` combined with `trustScore: 18/100` raises no visible flag during a standard registry review.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Add `Trust Score` as a default column in `VendorRegistry`. In the cell renderer: `{vendor.riskTier === 'low' && vendor.trustScore < 40 && (<Tooltip content="Trust Score is inconsistent with Low risk tier classification"><AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 inline ml-1" /></Tooltip>)}`. This surfaces contradictions without blocking workflow.
